acceptance.duplicate_gate: Versioned domain-tagged semantic-core key derived before writes; best-effort repository search for the proposed key and exact public Slack search for the proposed v44 decision token must return zero matches. Duplicate means no event, no CURRENT update, and no Slack.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Commit and read back this immutable event; fetch CURRENT again; update only if version=43, projection digest=2455b5352b56549f8dcb9ab966f3977692a5321b2e2289a7bb77cd3edf085c40, and blob=710a0b3b555447bd8136d3254e301aa0ef57f4a7; then read back CURRENT, this event, and predecessor.
acceptance.slack_rule: Before Git writes, inspect the prior v43 recovery pointer using exact public search and a bounded recent-channel read. If either surface finds one exact dual-anchor match, suppress any duplicate v43 recovery post. After final v44 Git readback, emit at most one sanitized v44 campaign-decision pointer. Do not rewrite CURRENT merely to embed the Slack link.
acceptance.stale_rule: Any wake not observing exact v43, prior digest 99ea58a8..., projection digest 2455b535..., and blob 710a0b3... must not advance.

campaign_decision.rationale: Four bounded wakes proved reconstruction after a controlled omission, duplicate suppression after a search hit, dual immutable lookup anchors, and eventual agreement between exact search and bounded channel read. Wake 3 also observed search lag immediately after posting. Retain Git as authority and Slack as a recoverable projection; require exact-token search plus bounded recent-channel read before retry, suppress on one exact dual-anchor match, and HOLD on disagreement or multiplicity. Do not claim crash recovery, different-carrier recovery, atomic uniqueness, or exactly-once delivery.

experiment.controlled_factor: Keep event canonicalization, v3 semantic-core idempotency, event-first write/readback, exact second CURRENT read, and single-file blob-SHA guard fixed; vary only recovery dedup observation from one non-atomic search surface to a two-stage exact-search plus bounded recent-channel read contract.
experiment.hypothesis: A recovery retry can suppress a duplicate Slack projection more safely when exact token search and bounded recent-channel read independently resolve the same one dual-anchor message; disagreement or multiplicity must not be treated as uniqueness.
experiment.strongest_falsifier: The proposed idempotency key or v44 decision token already exists; CURRENT is not exact v43 on the second read; event digest recomputation fails; final chain bindings disagree; search and bounded channel read disagree; either surface finds more than one dual-anchor message; a duplicate v43 recovery post occurs; or Slack is posted before final v44 Git readback.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This is still same-carrier, same-day, controlled recovery testing. Search and bounded channel history are separate, non-atomic observations and can both omit, lag, truncate, or duplicate data; a 100-message window is not a completeness proof. No real Slack outage, process crash, delayed replay across retention boundaries, or distinct-carrier recovery was tested. Git event creation, CURRENT replacement, validation reads, Slack reads, and Slack posting are separate effects. Git provides no cross-file atomicity, database isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, server-side idempotency uniqueness, Slack atomicity, lock fairness, or automatic orphan repair.
canonical_transition.rollback: Append a compensating event from the then-current version; never delete this event or Slack decision message; replace CURRENT only with its exact then-current blob SHA.
canonical_transition.transaction_time_evidence: AUTOMATION_RUNTIME_CLOCK+NATIVE_TASK_INVENTORY_READBACK+GITHUB_COMMIT_METADATA; Slack search/read/post and Git writes are not one transaction boundary
